Myth vs fact

4 things people believe about getting into banking.

Guess myth or fact before each swipe.

Myth #1

"You need a 4.0."

❌

GPA is one filter, not the whole story. Internships, a strong story and real conversations with bankers carry a lot of weight.

Myth #2

"Only finance majors get in."

❌

Banks hire econ, accounting, engineering, history and more. What matters is that you can do the technicals and explain why you want it.

Myth #3

"You recruit for internships senior year."

❌

Summer analyst roles are usually filled about a year ahead. Many students start networking as sophomores.

Fact ✅

"Networking actually matters."

✅

A referral or a good coffee chat can get your resume a second look. Start early and follow up.

Which one did you believe? 👇
